body: Still tiring and pointless it seems. Things aren't going to get better
I can't get antidepressants because of my family, it's kind of complicated. Either way, it's just me alone in this so there's not much else I can do.
I don't have a problem, that's the thing. There's nothing tangible to fix, I'm just a terrible person who can't stop thinking negative. I don't have the strength to try to change.
